Title: Jobs are not filtered by location - Near By returns the same as All Jobs
Steps to Reproduce: On the job feed, compare the Near By tab against All Jobs
Expected: Near By is geographically filtered
Actual: Same results
Reported By: QA - test execution 04-Aug-2026 (items 14-32; added to the doc AFTER the first triage)
Status: Open - root cause traced, needs client-side location capture
Root Cause / Fix: [QA doc item 32] NOT decided from code; the wiring looks correct. job-feed/page.tsx has a nearby tab that passes latitude/longitude (lines 162-174), so the failure is either browser geolocation being denied - PRIME SUSPECT: geolocation is a secure-context API and the test origin 103.225.224.149:3000 is plain HTTP, so the browser blocks it outright - or the BE not filtering on the coords. Retest on HTTPS or localhost BEFORE changing any code.  >> ROOT CAUSE TRACED 2026-08-18, and it is not what this row previously guessed. Geolocation permission over HTTP was the prime suspect and it is WRONG: the app never asks for geolocation at all. NOTHING POPULATES COORDINATES ANYWHERE. The portal's post-job form has no lat/long fields (CreateJobData carries none, though the BE validator accepts them); the portal never sets a seeker's coordinates; the mobile app has no location package in pubspec.yaml (no geolocator, no permission_handler) and no screen fills the latitude param its profile service exposes. Consequences: getNearbyForSeeker returns empty with noLocation:true for EVERY seeker; the location component of the recommendation score (up to 20 pts, Haversine + exponential decay past 10km) contributes 0 to EVERY job because the branch needs all four coordinates; and the portal's city dropdown filters on coordinates no job has. The whole geo subsystem is built correctly on the BE and fed by nothing. Fix is client-side data capture (geolocation permission on mobile, a geocoded address on the job form) - not a filter bug. Scope recorded in STATUS.md section 3.
